turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We don’t ship worldwide at this time.

• We ship within the contiguous United States, with limited availability to Alaska and Hawaii. • We also ship select items to certain regions in Canada.

For Canada specifically: • All required fees, taxes, duties, and certifications are included in the prices and shipping charges you see at checkout. • You do not need to arrange your own phytosanitary certificates or pay extra customs or duties on arrival; those are already handled on our side.

Outside the US and Canada, we currently are not able to ship orders.

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
eral timing

We use standard ground shipping only (no expedited or rush options).
Actual transit time varies by how far you are from our Oregon nurseries and the type of items in your order (roses, perennials, bulbs, or a mix), but the date you see at checkout is our best estimate based on carrier transit times.

If you tell me what you’re planning to order and your state or zip code, I can walk you through how to choose a good estimated delivery date for planting in your area.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping timing is a little different with us because you choose when you’d like your order to arrive.

Here’s how it works:

During checkout

In the delivery calendar, you pick an estimated arrival date (for US orders) based on your location.
The dates shown already factor in our processing time plus standard ground transit time to you.

If you use an express payment (like Shop Pay or PayPal)

Those checkouts skip the calendar step.
Our system will automatically assign an estimated arrival date based on your location and planting season, and you’ll see that date in your order confirmation email.

General timing

We use standard ground shipping only (no expedited or rush options).
Actual transit time varies by how far you are from our Oregon nurseries and the type of items in your order (roses, perennials, bulbs, or a mix), but the date you see at checkout is our best estimate based on carrier transit times.

If you tell me what you’re planning to order and your state or zip code, I can walk you through how to choose a good estimated delivery date for planting in your area.
